about.title: A little about how I work
about.subtitle: I like taking messy operational processes and figuring out how to make them predictable.
about.paragraph1: I'm a software and DevOps engineer working across cloud infrastructure, automation, testing, and application development. At AssetWorks, I work with the hosting team on systems that support customer environments in production.
about.paragraph2: A lot of my work starts with a process that has too many manual steps: provisioning a VM, checking an environment after maintenance, comparing configuration across servers, or verifying that data reached the reporting layer correctly. I turn those processes into workflows, pipelines, and checks that can be run consistently.
about.paragraph3: I also enjoy the infrastructure side of engineering—Kubernetes, AWS, Linux, networking, containers, observability, and CI/CD. When something breaks, I want to understand the path that led there and make the next occurrence easier to detect or prevent.

vmCreation.title: One-click VM Creation Automation
vmCreation.tagline: Turning a multi-day provisioning process into a repeatable infrastructure workflow.
vmCreation.description: Designed and implemented the VM provisioning workflow end-to-end with ManageIQ and embedded Ansible. The workflow validates the request, evaluates hypervisors, reserves an IP through OP ManageCentral, provisions a golden Windows VM, handles DNS and IP transactions, applies configuration, and validates the result. The previous process could take 7 days; the automated workflow provisions a VM in approximately 14 minutes.

syntheticTesting.title: Synthetic & Sanity Testing
syntheticTesting.tagline: Taking post-maintenance validation from 3 customers to 175+ environments.
syntheticTesting.description: Designed and executed automated validation using Azure DevOps, C#, and Playwright. The system checks login behavior, application access, database connectivity, and customer-specific success signals. Customer configuration was moved out of code so new environments could be onboarded without rewriting the tests, with grouped runs supporting large maintenance windows.

configurationDrift.title: Configuration Drift Detection
configurationDrift.tagline: Finding the server that doesn't match the rest.
configurationDrift.description: Implemented a configuration comparison system for WinRM-connected Windows servers using Python, PowerShell, Shell, and JavaScript. Rather than relying on manual file inspection, the system uses hashing, parsing, and comparison to identify differences across server state. A fan-out/fan-in workflow processes multiple servers and surfaces customer-specific drift through dashboards for shared and dedicated environments.

databaseWorkflow.title: Primary-to-Reporting Database Workflow Validation
databaseWorkflow.tagline: Following an order from the primary database to the reporting layer.
databaseWorkflow.description: Designed and executed end-to-end testing for the automated synchronization path between the Primary Database and Reporting Database. Tests covered order creation, primary writes, workflow execution, data transfer, reporting updates, consistency, customer access, failure scenarios, and isolation of the production data layer.

featured.description: Built RESTful FastAPI services and an AI-powered product discovery workflow supporting 100+ concurrent queries. Added ranking and relevance logic, automated CI/CD, 85% backend test coverage, and Docker-based deployment.
